data.case_title: Price increase for internet contract "Kabel 250" (Kabelnetz Beispielstadt)
data.title: Price increase notice for internet tariff "Kabel 250"
data.summary: Kabelnetz Beispielstadt GmbH informs Bastian Musterquell that the monthly price of his "Kabel 250" internet tariff will rise from €34.99 to €37.99, effective 1 February 2027.
data.explanation: Your internet provider is raising your monthly tariff price by €3.00 starting 1 February 2027. Because this increase is not entirely to your advantage, German law gives you a special right to cancel the contract free of charge and without the usual notice period, starting once you received this letter. You can decide whether to keep the contract at the new price or cancel it using this special right — the app will show you the deadline by which your cancellation must be received. If you do nothing, the new price simply takes effect automatically.
